values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Recompute exact tracked packet objects and normalized metadata; reject missing sources and stale target/digest identity.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('docs/reviews/v0.92/external-review-5847/packet-manifest.json')); abort 'identity missing' unless %w[target_sha digest repository base head].all? { |k| r[k] }; abort 'empty corpus' unless r['paths'].is_a?(Array) && !r['paths'].empty?

lanes.proof_role: Reject secrets/private state, invalid reviewer authority, mutable packet identity, unsafe links/commands, and unsupported approval language.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('docs/reviews/v0.92/external-review-5847/validation.json')); abort 'handoff blockers' unless r['blockers'].is_a?(Array) && r['blockers'].empty?

lanes.proof_role: Require a received reviewer-authored report and a complete provenance-preserving findings index before review completion.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('docs/reviews/v0.92/external-review-5847/findings-index.json')); abort 'report not received' unless r['report_received']==true; abort 'unindexed finding' unless r['source_count']==r.fetch('findings',[]).length
lanes.defer_reason: Run only after the operator-authorized reviewer response is actually received.

lanes.proof_role: Validate the exact rendered six-card bundle, cross-card references, digests, statuses, and canonical issue record.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on false completion claims, path collisions, invalid lifecycle state, or missing named proof; preserve a specific blocker instead of degrading.
